about: Reference photos (task 008): a real photo of each facade, landmark, bridge, roundabout, kind of wall and close-up the city needs, found online. what says what it shows: facade:way/<OSM id> (or relation/, or lidar/x<x>z<z> for a building the map lacks, where its middle is), landmark:<id>, bridge:way/<id>, roundabout:way/<id>, type:<a kind of building, task 017>, wall:<kind>, gate, garden, closeup:<kind>, or trees (a panorama's view of trees in leaf, for their species: task 088, tools/species.mjs summer). use is texture where the photo is straight on, sharp, evenly lit and clear, reference otherwise. heading, pitch and fov (horizontal, in degrees) are the part of the photo that shows it: what tools/refs.mjs cuts from a panorama. photo is the photo itself: its source, author, licence and link, and its camera (lat, lon, heading, pitch, roll) where known. generic: not Braga's own. Fetch them with node tools/refs.mjs.
credit: Photos © Mapillary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0; and from Wikimedia Commons, each under its own licence. The author, licence and link of each are under photo.

photos.name: Capela de Santa Justa
photos.notes: Its granite front straight on, in the sun: the cross on its little curved pediment, the door under the inscription and its cornice, the saint's tiles, the bell gable on the white block to its right. Commons puts the camera on the chapel itself: where it stood, and the way it looked, are as the photo frames the front, from the pavement across the street.

photos.name: Capela de Santa Justa
photos.notes: Up the Rua Monsenhor Airosa, as the race comes to it: the bell gable over the white houses, the granite gable beyond it. The viewpoint capela-santa-justa.

photos.name: Capela de Santa Justa
photos.notes: From the north, 38 m off: its white north side with a dark door, granite at its corner, its tiled roof.

photos.name: Capela de Santo Adrião
photos.notes: The porch from before it and its south side: granite columns on low rubble walls, the round-arched door, two barred windows, the bell gable on the apex. No position on Commons: where it stood and the way it looked, as the photo frames it.

photos.name: Capela de Santo Adrião
photos.notes: Its south side from the lawn: rubble granite under a tiled roof, a small window, the porch at its west end under a hipped roof, the bell gable over it. No position on Commons: as the photo frames it.

photos.name: Capela de Santo Adrião
photos.notes: From the road the race takes, up its bank: its north side and the porch. It frames the chapel at 206°, not at the phone's compass's 186.8°. The viewpoint capela-santo-adriao.

photos.name: Capela de Santa Tecla
photos.notes: Its front straight on: white render framed in granite, the cornice, the pediment with the saint in her niche, the pinnacles, the great cross on its scrolled block; the green door under the inscription (1729), a barred window either side, the steps. The gate's shadows on it, so a reference only. No position on Commons: as the photo frames it.

photos.name: Capela de Santa Tecla
photos.notes: The inscription over its door, close: "A CUSTA DE JOZE PINHEYRO LEYTE ANNO 1729", the door dark green. Taken where the one before was.
